                                  13           Plaintiff in this action is proceeding pro se. On September 5, 2025, the Court denied

                                  14   Plaintiff’s application to proceed in forma pauperis after Plaintiff failed to supply complete

                                  15   information in support of his application in response to the Court’s August 14, 2025 Order. Dkt.

                                  16   nos. 4, 6. In the September 5, 2025 Order, the Court ordered that Plaintiff pay the filing fee no

                                  16          Plaintiff Robert Boyd has filed an application to proceed in forma pauperis in this case.

                                  17   Dkt. no. 2 (“Application”). The Court cannot determine from the information supplied whether

                                  18   Boyd qualifies for in forma pauperis status. In particular, in his response to Question No. 1, Boyd

                                  19   states that the last wages or salary he received was a “March Youtube Payment” but he does not

                                  20   state the amount of that payment. The Court also notes that both the caption of the complaint and

                                  21   the Application list a second plaintiff, “Rob Run Corleone LLC.” No financial information has

                                  22   been supplied as to that entity. Finally, in an attachment to the Complaint, Plaintiffs states that in

                                  23   addition to receiving $2000/month from YouTube, before his account was blocked, Boyd also

                                  24   received $800 a month in licensing fees for his music from “Empire.” However, no licensing fees

                                  25   are listed in the Application.

                                  26          Accordingly, Plaintiff Robert Boyd shall file an amended application that provides more

                                  27   complete information about his financial circumstances. In addition, a separate application shall

                                  28   be filed providing financial information for Plaintiff Rob Run Corleone LLC. These materials
